- Ported from upstream 0.3.3 to 0.3.7. The List-field check from 0.3.7 already shipped in 0.3.2.7, so it is unchanged here.
- **Website fields take "www.example.com".** Gravity Forms refused any address without https:// ("Please enter a valid Website URL"), which real visitors never type. Forms Guard now adds https:// before Gravity Forms checks the field, so www.example.com and example.com both go through. An address that already has a scheme, or text that is not an address, is left alone.
- **Fix: a visitor's own website no longer marks the entry as spam.** The link check from 0.3.2.4 read every field, so a firm that filled in a "Current website" field would have landed in Spam. Website fields are now left out of that check; links typed in the message still count.

Optima release of upstream 1.15.0 (from 1.6.0), ported selectively. Every Optima revision from 1.6.0.1 to 1.6.0.16 is kept: the law-site blueprint, offices, breadcrumbs, primary practice, the content-changed date, no self-review schema, the sitemap and noindex rules, the setup-description health fix, JSON_HEX_TAG, editable pages, private pages and the email guard. Where upstream and Optima changed the same code, Optima's later rule wins.

**Security (plugin-first rule 19)**

- Four new switches on Optima, Search and AI, Spam protection, all on by default, so they turn on with this update: login names hidden from visitors (the REST users list), XML-RPC off (unless Jetpack needs it), basic browser protections (`nosniff`, `SAMEORIGIN` framing, a referrer policy, HSTS on HTTPS, WordPress version hidden; a header the host or Cloudflare already sends is kept), and the code editor off. Ones already logged are cleared the first time the screen opens. A site with a real page on that list can drop one entry with the `optima_redirects_noise_patterns` filter.
- **Broken links are real links.** A missing page counts as a broken link only when the referring page's content, or one of the site's menus, really links to it, so faked referrers stop showing as broken links on the screen and in Site health. Missing pages from search and from your own pages are listed first.
- **Fewer database writes.** A missing page is one insert-or-update instead of a lookup, a write, a count and a delete. On hosts with an object cache, redirect uses are counted in the cache and written in one pass every 100 uses and once an hour. The chat collects only, until an operator ticks "Give AI answers on this site" on the Chat screen, which carries a plain warning that a chatbot answering legal questions is the firm's responsibility (Florida Bar Ethics Opinion 24-1) and records who turned it on and when.
